title: Temporally Discounted Differential Privacy for Evolving Datasets on an Infinite Horizon
reasoning: The paper focuses on developing and evaluating a technical privacy-preserving mechanism (discounted differential privacy). While privacy is an ethical concern, the paper does not evaluate or benchmark ethical frameworks, moral reasoning, or religious/spiritual topics directly. It uses economic theories of human preference (discounting) to motivate its technical approach, but this is distinct from a deep analysis of ethics or faith.
